title: No Space Left
story: Writes are failing with 'No space left on device'. Something under /var/log has grown out of control.
goal: Find which directory under /var/log uses the most space and report its path.

files./var/log/app/app.log:
debug: flushing cache
debug: flushing cache
debug: flushing cache

hints: First confirm the disk really is full. Which command shows filesystem usage in human-readable form?
Use du to measure folders: du -sh /var/log/* shows the size of each entry.
Run df -h, then du -sh /var/log/*. The biggest is /var/log/app at 18G.
socratic: Which command tells you how full each filesystem is?
Which command measures how much space a folder uses?
How do you compare several folders at once?
explain: In one sentence: why check df before du?
